Package nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.app

Class Recorders

java.lang.Object
nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.app.Recorders
public class Recorders extends Object
Class which contains the Recorders that will be recording the game. The player has the option to decide whether to record a game or not, so when the instance of the "Recorders" class is created, no recorders are initially created.

      public void forwardActionToRecorder(PlayerAction action)

      Asks the user whether they want the game to be recorded or not. If they ask for the game to be recorded, then they need to select where to store the files!
